Officer.</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">  </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The agreement entered into with Mr. Ramirez is an updated form of Non-Competition, Non-Solicitation and Severance Benefit Agreement (the &#8220;2025 SBA&#8221;) approved by the Human Capital and Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company.</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">  </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The 2025 SBA is expected to be used with future executive officers of the Company, subject to further approval by the Committee.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The 2025 SBA is substantially similar to the Company&#8217;s prior form of Non-Competition, Non-Solicitation and Severance Benefit Agreement (the &#8220;2023 SBA&#8221;) but amends the 2023 SBA by, among other things:</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%;padding-left:13.8pt">providing that, consistent with the Company&#8217;s broad-based severance benefit plan that applies generally to employees of the Company, all severance payments payable under a 2025 SBA will be paid in a single lump sum and providing for a single lump sum payment in lieu of contributions to the cost of health care continuation following termination of employment;</span></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times Non-Solicitation and Severance Benefit Agreement (an &#8220;Agreement&#8221;) with each of Dominic Dragisich, David Pepper, Scott Oaksmith and Simone Wu (each, an &#8220;Amendment&#8221;) to provide that, to the extent necessary to comply with Section 409A of the Code, any amount of severance payable in connection with a change in control (as defined in the Agreement) that is determined not to be exempt from Section 409A shall be paid in installments in accordance with the Company&#8217;s normal payroll practices. The Amendments also clarify that all amounts payable under an Agreement are subject to all applicable tax withholding and add expanded and updated provisions related to protected rights and Section
